pages.text: $(bold)Dragon Blood Tank$() (Default trait of Dragon Bone)$(br2)Effect: +5000 mB capacity per level (max 25000 mB), capable of storing$(bold)all three types of dragon blood$() (Fire / Ice / Lightning Dragon Blood).$(br2)Usage: $(bold)Right-click dragons$() with the tool in hand to collect their blood into the tank; the blood can combine with the $(bold)Dragon Blood Infusion$() trait to apply Ignite / Frost / Disarm effects to weapons.
